verdict.rationale: CockroachDB Cloud's official MCP server docs say users can interact with clusters through natural-language prompts to list tables, execute statements and insert rows. They also say AI tools can explore live schemas and run queries using OAuth or API keys. However, this works only through an external AI client connected over MCP, and the documented scope is data and schema operations rather than full product operation. Missing for 10: a native built-in natural-language interface, natural-language cluster administration (provisioning, scaling, backups), coverage for self-hosted deployments, and independent hands-on corroboration.
